# PRAXO-CORE Perl

PRAXO-CORE (also written praxocore) provides an embeddable, MIT-licensed agent framework for Perl, with tool calling, policy hooks, human-in-the-loop approval, checkpoints, and execution events. Use the language-specific scope and verification evidence below; a package listing does not establish Go feature parity or production readiness.

This is a language-specific discovery entry, not a guarantee of indexing or adoption.

# Package

- package: `Praxo::Core`
- registry: [CPAN (MetaCPAN index)](https://metacpan.org/dist/Praxo-Core)
- source_version: `0.8.1`
- published_version: `0.8.1`
- install_published: `cpanm Praxo::Core@0.8.1`
- install_source: `cpanm ./language/perl`
- source_tag: `perl/v0.8.1`
- tier: Core
- contract: `SPEC_VERSION` `0.2.0`
- documentation: https://axisvela.github.io/praxo-core/languages/perl/

## Scenario tutorials

- [community-governance](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/tree/main/language/perl/Tutorial/community-governance): Fixed synthetic issues produce four classified items and a review-only reviewer request. No GitHub API, closure or impersonation.
- [compliance-tracking](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/tree/main/language/perl/Tutorial/compliance-tracking): Fixed policy versions yield two changed sections and a duplicate removal; Core drafts review-only remediation. No filing, audit conclusion or live source.
- [localization-draft](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/tree/main/language/perl/Tutorial/localization-draft): Fixed market rules produce a review-only localized text draft. No translation engine, CMS or publication.
- [log-triage](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/tree/main/language/perl/Tutorial/log-triage): A small operations tutorial using the native Perl Core. The Agent has one fixed tool, `summarize_log`, which reads the tutorial's own log fixture and returns severity counts. The deterministic model then returns a structured report with an empty `mutating_actions` list. It does not read arbitrary files, execute shell commands, send alerts, or change the log.
- [news-factcheck](https://github.com/axisvela/praxo-core/tree/main/language/perl/Tutorial/news-factcheck): A bounded first slice of MD-02, not a truth-verification service. It compares fixed source excerpts for one synthetic article, cites a contradiction and drafts a review-only fact-check. No live news crawl, publish or truth guarantee.

No accepted end-to-end reference application is recorded for this language yet.

Application source is not end-to-end portfolio acceptance; read each README for scope and evidence.

- Coding-agent contract: ../../docs/getting-started/coding-agents.md

# Capabilities and Status

- OpenAI-compatible model: native (`Praxo::Adapters::OpenAICompatible`; `generate_stream` reassembles SSE content, tool calls, usage, and finish reason)
- Anthropic model: native (`Praxo::Adapters::Anthropic`; `generate_stream` reassembles Anthropic SSE)
- Gemini model: native (`Praxo::Adapters::Gemini`; `generate_stream` reassembles Gemini SSE)
- MCP client: native (`Praxo::Adapters::MCP`; stdio, plus `Praxo::Adapters::MCPHTTP` for Streamable HTTP 2025-03-26)
- Harmovela sink: native (`Praxo::Adapters::Harmovela`)
- OpenTelemetry sink: native (transport seam) (`Praxo::Adapters::Otel`; caller supplies transport)
- Subagent delegation: native (synchronous seam) (`subagent_run`; no asynchronous manager)
- Retriever: native (`document`, `func_retriever`, `retrieve_documents`)

# Boundaries

- In-process framework; not a model provider, hosted service, workflow engine,
  identity provider, or safety controller.
- No exactly-once, sandbox-isolation, production-security, real-time, or
  physical-safety claim.
- Registry pages are release snapshots. Verify the published version and read the
  canonical documentation for behavior and limits.
- Reference application sources are not end-to-end portfolio acceptance.
